newsitem.title: FINLAND: METRA SAYS WARTSILA-SULZER MERGER READY.
newsitem.headline: METRA SAYS WARTSILA-SULZER MERGER READY.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Metra Oy Ab said on Friday the merger of its Wartsila Diesel unit with Swiss engine maker New Sulzer Diesel had been completed.
"Metra and Fincantieri Cantieri Navali Italiani S.p.A. completed on April 3, 1997 the merger of Wartsila Diesel and New Sulzer Diesel," Metra said in a statement.
Italian state shipbuilder Fincantieri is part of state industrial holding IRI.
The merger was announced in September last year.
Metra holds 87.8 percent and Fincantieri 12.2 percent in Wartsila NSD, Metra said. Wartsila NSD's 1997 net sales are expected to exceed 11 billion markka in 1997, it said.
